claim_one_line: L136 -- THE ADJOINT-FORM HATCH CLOSES ITSELF, discharging the single hatch B959 left open. NO PREREGISTRATION, DELIBERATELY and flagged as an OPEN-AND-SHUT READING (as B957 was): the answer is a one-line consequence of a standard fact and appeared the moment the question was posed, so sealing after seeing it would be worse than not sealing. THE QUESTION: B959 proved no centralizer construction reaches rank 4 with a complex 27, but its torality step used Steinberg's theorem and assumed the SIMPLY CONNECTED form, while in the ADJOINT form E6/Z3 a rank-2 elementary abelian subgroup CAN be non-toral and A4/S5 do supply rank 2 -- so which form does the object's E6 live in? THE ANSWER, computed: det(Cartan matrix of E6) = 3 so the centre of the simply connected form is Z/3; and the fundamental weights' root-lattice membership is omega_1 NO, omega_2 YES, omega_3 NO, omega_4 YES, omega_5 NO, omega_6 NO -- so the 27's highest weight is NOT in the root lattice, the centre Z/3 ACTS NONTRIVIALLY on the 27, and THE 27 IS A REPRESENTATION OF THE SIMPLY CONNECTED E6 ONLY: the adjoint form E6/Z3 HAS NO 27, its representations being exactly those of trivial central character (78, 650, ...). WHY THIS CLOSES THE HATCH RATHER THAN MERELY ANSWERING IT: the hatch was an escape route -- work in the adjoint form where non-toral rank-2 subgroups exist and rank 4 might be reachable -- but ESCAPING TO THE ADJOINT FORM COSTS YOU THE 27, THE VERY OBJECT WHOSE CHIRALITY WAS THE ENTIRE POINT. There is no configuration in which the escape helps: where the matter lives the form is simply connected, and where the form is adjoint there is no matter. So the simply connected form is FORCED by the presence of the 27, B959's torality step applies without qualification, and B959's NO-GO IS COMPLETE WITHIN ITS CLASS: no centralizer construction on this object -- measurement, holonomy, or finite image -- can produce chiral matter at the Standard Model's rank. WHAT IS STILL NOT CLAIMED: this does NOT say the object cannot reach the SM, since B955 established that E6 -> SU(5) via two 27 VEVs achieves rank 6->4 with the 27 still complex and that this is STANDARD -- what is excluded is the class of operations the object HAS, not the target itself, and a Higgs-type mechanism remains unexcluded and unsupplied; the class is specifically 'centralizer constructions', so anything outside it (a VEV, an orbifold projection, a quotient that is not a commutant) is untouched; and the standard facts used (det Cartan = 3, centre Z/3, adjoint reps = root-lattice weights) are CITED, with only the lattice-membership computation run here.
